about: Logic capture streams (capture §1.1): the configure answer's layout (w, pos), the channels' levels (`channels[k]`, character i = the level of channel k in sample i, channels in role order) and the segment's stream. Bits no pos names and the bits of the last byte past N*w are undefined (any value; 0 here); a host ignores them.
